newsitem.title: USA: CSCE cocoa called to open little changed.
newsitem.headline: CSCE cocoa called to open little changed.

text.p: CSCE cocoa futures were called to open little changed Friday on the heels of a lackluster performance in London overnight, traders said.
LIFFE cocoa futures were flat to firmer in thin, rangebound dealings early Friday. At the midday break, July was up four stg at 1,010 stg a tonne, with September three stg higher at 1,025.

Thursday, New York cocoa futures ended weaker in light trade, but managed to recover from their lows. July closed down $6 at $1,422 a tonne after trading from $1,426 to $1,412. Spot May, which expires in a week, ended $11 lower at $1,412, while the back months eased $1 to $3.
Technically, traders pegged support at $1,400, with resistance seen at Wednesday's high of $1,432 for July. ((--Patricia Avidan, New York Commodity Desk 212 859 1640))
